new_spots.name: Orana Wildlife Park
new_spots.bio_fix: New Zealand's only open-range zoo, with endangered animals from around the world and a Lion Encounter.
new_spots.photo_reason: Otters in an enclosure; real animals, colour, 2016; weak (not the park) but acceptable for a wildlife spot as the proposal says.
new_spots.note: Bio says 'drive-through lion reserve' but Wikipedia says the drive-through reserve closed in 1995 and is now a Lion Encounter. 'largest wildlife sanctuary' is Wikivoyage-only; 'only open-range zoo' is the safer claim.

new_spots.note: Bio refers to another spot ('than Orana'); each bio should stand alone. Facts per Wikivoyage/Wikipedia.
